title: Immunolabeling of a Whole Mouse Brain
author: Rajvi Javeri

steps.title: Prepare starting brain sample
steps.instruction: Start with a whole mouse brain that has been perfused with 4 % PFA, post‑fixed, and stored in PBS in a 20 mL vial.

steps.title: Incubate brain with primary antibody
steps.instruction: Transfer the brain to a 4 mL Shorty vial containing ~4 mL PTxw with diluted primary antibody (15 µg per brain for unconjugated primary, 30 µg per brain for primary‑conjugated antibody). Incubate with rocking, a nutator, or a shaker at 4 °C for 11 days.

steps.title: Wash brain with PTxw (series 1)
steps.instruction: Transfer the brain to a 20 mL liquid scintillation vial and wash with PTxw while rocking on a nutating mixer or shaker at room temperature, replacing the solution for each wash as follows:

steps.title: Additional overnight PTxw wash
steps.instruction: Using a 20 mL glass vial, wash the brain with PTxw while rotating at room temperature overnight.

steps.title: Spin down secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Spin down the desired secondary antibody in a centrifuge at 10 000 rpm for 1 minute (temperature not specified) and retain the supernatant for immunolabeling.

steps.title: Incubate brain with secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Transfer the brain to a 4 mL Shorty vial containing ~4 mL PTxw with diluted secondary antibody (30 µg per brain). Incubate with rocking at 4 °C for 11 days.

steps.title: Wash brain with new PTxw solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a new PTxw solution containing 200 mM NaCl and 0.1 % Tween; use this solution for all remaining washes. Transfer the brain to a 20 mL liquid scintillation vial and wash with the new PTxw while rocking at room temperature, replacing the solution for each wash as follows:

steps.title: Wash brain with 1X PBS
steps.instruction: Wash the brain with 1X PBS while rocking at room temperature overnight.

steps.title: Store immunolabeled brain
steps.instruction: Store the immunolabeled brain in 0.01 % PBS azide at 4 °C.
